workstreams.title: FOP content, mapping, engagement and plan transition
workstreams.limitations: Plans and amendments must be checked against actual authorizations, approval dates and transitional provisions.

workstreams.title: Cutblock size and §64 exceptions
workstreams.limitations: Only 60-ha Omineca numeric trigger is drafted. Other regions, exception paths and historical amendments need reviewer approval.

workstreams.title: Adjacent harvest openings and regeneration
workstreams.limitations: Adjacency has a contextual statutory meaning; fixed-buffer spatial proximity alone is not proof.

workstreams.title: Wildlife tree retention within block and reporting area
workstreams.limitations: Individual and annual landscape calculations have different denominators and exceptions.

workstreams.title: Soil disturbance and permanent access
workstreams.limitations: DEM slope cannot establish soil sensitivity, compaction or permanent access by itself.

workstreams.title: Riparian classes, setbacks and restricted activities
workstreams.limitations: Mapped centreline distance without stream classification, slope distance and exceptions is only a preliminary screen.

workstreams.title: Stream protection, fish passage and crossings
workstreams.limitations: Absence of mapped fish habitat is not evidence of absence.

workstreams.title: Community watersheds and potable water constraints
workstreams.limitations: Orders and field conditions can add constraints beyond base regulation.

workstreams.title: Road construction, bridges and deactivation
workstreams.limitations: Engineering manual recommendations and binding regulations must remain separately identified.

workstreams.title: WHA, UWR, wildlife measures and sensitive features
workstreams.limitations: Some protected features are intentionally confidential; never treat absent public polygons as unregulated.

workstreams.title: Scenic areas and visual quality
workstreams.limitations: A modeled viewshed is supporting evidence, not a substitute for the legal objective and professional assessment.

workstreams.title: Prince George TSA old-forest retention
workstreams.limitations: 25 Prince George old-retention percentages extracted, but current order applicability and qualifying old-forest accounting are not established.

workstreams.title: Prince George TSA old interior forest
workstreams.limitations: 25 interior shares extracted. Divide by required old forest, not total landbase; guidance buffering is not legal text.

workstreams.title: Prince George TSA Table 7 young forest patch trends
workstreams.limitations: 9 target vectors extracted. The legal objective is a trend, not pass/fail by nearest target; exact 50-ha boundary needs interpretation.

workstreams.title: Approved alternatives, record of reasoning and order replacement
workstreams.limitations: A source link or claimed exception never substitutes for a legally valid approval.
